title: Open a folder
description: `{ path, create?, ledger?, keepOutOfGit? }`: the folder to open, under the home folder, whether to create its Vision Board (or, with ledger folders, the ledger) when it has none, and which ledger.

create.description: True makes `.visionboard/` and an empty ledger when the folder (with ledger folders: the ledger named) has none; false (the default) refuses such a folder or ledger with `not-found`.

ledger.description: With ledger folders, the ledger to open; left out, the one this folder had open last, else `main`. Ignored without ledger folders.

keepOutOfGit.description: With `create` and ledger folders, true writes a `.gitignore` of `*` into the new ledger's folder, so git never sees it (a throwaway ledger). Ignored when the ledger is already there.
